payload.posture: Read 2 Chronicles 7:1–22 as evidence about the Temple, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states fire consumes the offerings, glory fills the house, the priests cannot enter, and the assembly bows and praises. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Temple.
